36.3 Transactions with key management personnel (KMP)
According to Sri Lanka Accounting Standard LKAS 24 "Related Party Disclosures", Key Management Personnel, are those
having authority and responsibility for planning, directing and controlling the activities of the entity, directly or indirectly,
including any director (whether executive or otherwise) of that entity and its parent entity. Accordingly, the Board of
Directors, Chief Executive Officer and their immediate family members have been classified as key management personnel of
the entity and its parent entity.
Close Family Members of a Key Management Person are those family members who may be expected to influence, or be
influenced by, that individual in their dealings with the Entity. They may include;
